a.name: Warm chalice bell
a.desc: A warm, low temple bell that rings softly and fades away.
a.note: Main: ChaliceChime (E4 330 Hz with 887/1630 partials, sustained) lowpassed for warmth; a quiet tonal sparkle (shimmer sparkle-1) on top for the magic. Long soft fade.

b.name: Airy wind chimes
b.desc: A light brush of wind chimes with a faint crystal sparkle.
b.note: Main: Zaphir chimes (metal rods, one cluster then a long thin tail). A quiet, highpassed atonal crystal chime run adds sparkle without a tune.

layers.credit: "MAGShim_Atonal Crystal Chime Transition.Short x20_EM" by newlocknew, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/newlocknew/sounds/773403

c.name: Two glass tones
c.desc: Two clear glass notes ringing softly, one just after the other.
c.note: Main: wine glass (D#5 607 Hz, pure, slow decay). Second glass (C#6) pitched -3 to A#5 enters at 140 ms, a soft fifth above. No metal: clean glass.

a.name: Strap and forge ring
a.desc: A leather strap tugs tight, a buckle clicks, then steel rings.
a.note: Main: anvil, forging hot steel (F#6, short ring) at 90 ms. Before it a small leather handle tug and the rpg metal latch: armour being tightened, then the strength ring.

layers.credit: "Anvil - Lokomo A 100 kg - Forging hot steel 1 time short" by ldezem, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/ldezem/sounds/386117

b.name: Bright blade ring
b.desc: A bright blade rings out clean, with a tiny bell on top.
b.note: Main: Dagger (4 kHz ringing blade, shing then long tonal tail). A quiet small bell (B7) adds a magic glint. Bright, clean, metallic.

c.name: Rising bronze chimes
c.desc: Three small bronze gong notes climbing upward, quick and hopeful.
c.note: Main: talempong (bronze gong-chime, C#6) at 0; talempong 05 pitched +3 (F#6) at 85 ms; talempong 03 pitched +9 (A#6) at 170 ms: a rising major arpeggio, old and mystical.

a.name: Low wobbling toll
a.desc: A dull low thud with a deep bowl that wobbles and sours.
a.note: Main: singing bowl strike 2 (strong beating) pitched -5 and lowpassed: the beating becomes a slow wobble. A close body thump gives the hit.

layers.credit: "singing bowl - single strike 2" by s-light, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/s-light/sounds/411483

b.name: Wet rot splat
b.desc: A heavy wet squelch, like rotten mush slapped onto skin.
b.note: Main: wet splat squish 01 (low 265 Hz wet body), entered at 90 ms into the file so its loudest squelch lands early. Wet Splat 2 on the very front for a sharp slap (also hides the cut); a low carpet thump pitched down for weight.

c.name: Groaning rotten wood
c.desc: A dark drum thud and old wood groaning under the weight.
c.note: Main: creaking and groaning door, first groan only (0-550 ms), pitched -3 and lowpassed so it reads as rotting timber. A dark timpani under it gives the low hit at the start.

layers.credit: "creaking and groaning door" by odilonmarcenaro, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/odilonmarcenaro/sounds/271578

a.name: Seal stamp and bowl
a.desc: A firm seal stamp pressed down, with a soft bowl ring after.
a.note: Main: Stamp (814 Hz, sharp 16 ms thock). A bright singing bowl strike, quiet and short, rings under it as the chime.

layers.credit: "singing bowl strike sound" by inoshirodesign, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/inoshirodesign/sounds/271370

b.name: Metal click and ping
b.desc: A small metal catch clicks shut with a soft glass ping.
b.note: Main: Kenney rpg metal click (bright, short catch). Kenney interface glass ping (1.9 kHz, soft) 15 ms after: a click plus a soft chime.

c.name: Wood knock and gong
c.desc: A dry knock on wood with a faint shrine gong behind it.
c.note: Main: Kenney light wood impact (379 Hz, dry knock). A small shrine gong (Kashiwa, 2.4 kHz) very quiet underneath for the magic tag.

a.name: Soft bowl fade
a.desc: A muffled low bowl tone that quickly fades to nothing.
a.note: Main: singing bowl strike 3 (F#3) pitched -2, lowpassed at 1.6 kHz so the strike is soft; short with a long fade. Quiet sibling of the warm heal bell.

layers.credit: "singing bowl - single strike 3" by s-light, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/s-light/sounds/415138

b.name: Reversed metal shimmer
b.desc: A short backwards ring that swells and vanishes, leaving a faint glint.
b.note: Main: reversed metal pole hit, cut to 150-296 ms (starts near -22 dB, ends just before the reversed attack spike so there is no click) and pitched +5 so the swell lasts about 110 ms; lowpassed to stay soft. A very quiet lowpassed glass ding (-18 dB) at the cut-off leaves a faint after-glint so the end is not abrupt.

c.name: Candle snuffed out
c.desc: A soft breath puff, like blowing out a small candle.
c.note: Main: Blowing Out Candle_shorter (soft puff, 233 ms, peak at 129 ms) pitched -2. A second candle blow quieter underneath for body.
